source_summary: Defines research-intake completion as the governed transaction from first-contact preservation through queue registration, research identity, provisional research structure, projection, validation, and terminal research registration or visible blocking.
core_rule: USER_INDUCTS_ARTIFACT => PRESERVE => QUEUE_REGISTER => RESEARCH_REGISTER => VALIDATE => TERMINATE
migration_scope: inducted records lacking research identity or required research projections
capture_limitations: Chat semantic capture is normalized from the received governance packet; preserved source remains immutable.
